Messages.Author: Lev Steshenko
Messages.Body:
Lets say that I bleed someone.
He blocks and in combat I play Form of Mist to continue the action at +1
stealth.
My opponent then plays Psyche to restart combat.
In combat I play Earth Meld to untap.

Do I still continue the action at +1 stealth?
Am I tapped if no one blocks the bleed?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Lev Steshenko wrote:
>
> Lets say that I bleed someone.
> He blocks and in combat I play Form of Mist to continue the action at +1
> stealth.
> My opponent then plays Psyche to restart combat.
> In combat I play Earth Meld to untap.
>
> Do I still continue the action at +1 stealth?

No. FoM's "continue action" effect was lost as soon as another
combat started.

> Am I tapped if no one blocks the bleed?

Moot. There's no bleed anymore.

--
